title: Escape jq string interpolation in tool/linear-sync.sh before it corrupts YAML on titles/authors containing a quote
rule: Tier-2 AREA NOTE: correctness of tooling (silent corruption)
why: All 5 sites build a quoted YAML scalar by raw string-concatenating a Linear-supplied value (issue title, or comment author name) between literal backslash-quotes, with no escaping of embedded `"` characters. Any Linear issue titled e.g. `Fix "broken" login` (or a comment author display name containing a quote) produces a line like `title: "Fix "broken" login"` in sprint-status.yaml, the per-story .yaml cache files, AND the generated epics.md — a malformed value with no error raised anywhere in the pipeline (set -e doesn't catch it, since jq itself succeeds). Downstream, docs/planning/epics.md's AUTO:EPIC-LIST block (also written by this script) silently carries the corrupted text into checked-in documentation.
recommendation: Replace the raw `"...\"" + .field + "\""` concatenation with jq's `(.field | tojson)` (or `@json`) at all 5 sites, which correctly escapes embedded quotes/backslashes/newlines and is still valid YAML flow-scalar syntax.
acceptance_criteria: Feed a synthetic Linear issue JSON with a `"` in .title (and .user.name for comments) through the jq filters; the emitted YAML parses cleanly via `python3 -c "import yaml,sys;yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin)"` or `yq`.
All 5 sites (lines 301, 323, 336, 381, 388) use tojson/@json instead of manual quote concatenation.
